'''Skein''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Skein was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. When the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] devolved into open war against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Skein was raised to the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Due to the Confederacy's employment of Force-users and other dangerous beings, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] found it necessary to reopen an ancient prison facility known as [[The Prism]]. Assigning Skein to the facility in secret, the warden of the clandestine [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was attended by one hundred [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] to assist in the day to day operations of the facility. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited the facility to conduct a survey of the living conditions of the prisoners. By the end of the war, the facility was attended by [[Unidentified Prism Jedi|another Jedi Master]].<ref name="GP3" />
